title: Verifier result tool contract
description: v2.22 §2.B2 — input_schema for the report_verifier tool forced via tool_choice. Shared by the batch (Phase Transition T1) and per-task Verifier dispatches. Mirrors references/verifier-prompt.md Result JSON: a PASS/FAIL/ESCALATE status with verification-evidence commands_run/exit_codes, FAIL issues[]/category, and ESCALATE blocker/options.

status.description: PASS when all risk-tier checks/AC pass with no new failures vs baseline; FAIL on a real failure; ESCALATE when unresolvable.

exit_codes.description: Exit code per command in commands_run.

issues.description: Present on FAIL — the failing-test details.

category.description: Optional on FAIL; one of the ENV_BLOCKER triage categories from references/escalation-playbook.md (default "other").

blocker.description: Present on ESCALATE — the unresolvable blocker.

options.description: Present on ESCALATE — remediation options for the orchestrator.
